name: BMI Calculator
implementationConventions: BMI=kg/m²; CDC adult20+ thresholds18.5,25,30,35,40; classify before rounding. Pediatric2-19 uses official CDC LMS percentile dataset and exact age in months.
limitationsAndDependencies: Do not apply adult categories to children or label bodyfat/diagnosis from BMI. Child data is required for parity, not fabricated percentiles.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Calorie Calculator
implementationConventions: BMR formula family then activity multiplier. Nutritional kcal=4184J=4.184kJ; small calorie=4.184J. Goal deficits are explicit rough scenarios, not guaranteed linear weight change.
limitationsAndDependencies: Adult nonpregnant estimates. Do not supply extreme or underweight-loss targets. Do not promise static3500kcal/lb trajectory. Katch provenance/activity coefficients require explicit method labeling.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Body Fat Calculator
implementationConventions: Legacy male BF%=86.010log10(abdomenIn-neckIn)-70.041log10(heightIn)+36.76;female=163.205log10(waistIn+hipIn-neckIn)-97.684log10(heightIn)-78.387. Conversion toinches before formulas. LBM=W*(1-BF/100).
limitationsAndDependencies: Exact independent primary provenance of these legacy Navy coefficients and any Deurenberg BMI variants still needs verifying; reject nonpositive log arguments and implausibleoutputs, do not clamp silently. Not currentArmytest.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: BMR Calculator
implementationConventions: See energy family. Mifflin predicts resting expenditure, which is not a direct measured basal test; Katch requires actual body-fat input.
limitationsAndDependencies: No clinical nutrition prescription; illness,pregnancy,children andbodycomposition changes limit accuracy.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Macro Calculator
implementationConventions: Use declared energy model;proteinGrams=calories*proteinShare/4;carbGrams=calories*carbShare/4;fatGrams=calories*fatShare/9. Shares sum1.
limitationsAndDependencies: Activity/intake assumptions must be visible; do not pretend one split fits medical conditions or pregnancy.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Ideal Weight Calculator
implementationConventions: Height excessx=inches-60. Robinsonkg male52+1.9x,female49+1.7x;Devine50+2.3x/45.5+2.3x;Miller56.2+1.41x/53.1+1.36x;Hamwilb106+6x/100+5x.
limitationsAndDependencies: Historical estimates, primarily adult >=60in derivations; avoid extrapolating tochildren/shortheight without qualification. Hamwi exact lb and rounded kg variants differ;label variant. Not an appearance goal.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Pregnancy Calculator
implementationConventions: Compute EDD then gestational age and dates of weeks/trimesters using calendar arithmetic; display estimated timeline only.
limitationsAndDependencies: Clinical ultrasound/ART dating supersedes simple calendar estimate. Never identify exact conception or guarantee deliverydate.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator
implementationConventions: Singleton totalgainlb:underweight28-40,normal25-35,overweight15-25,obesity11-20;twins50-62/37-54/31-50/25-42 respectively. Compare observed gain.
limitationsAndDependencies: Per-week bands require CDC/IOM tracker methodology; linear0-to40week interpolation is not clinically validated. Underweighttwins has different source. Triplets/higherBMI individualizedcare.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Pregnancy Conception Calculator
implementationConventions: EDD-266days gives central estimated conception;derive alternative estimates consistently. Fertility window includes sperm survival and ovulationuncertainty.
limitationsAndDependencies: No exact conception/paternity conclusions; exact window width must be sourced rather than arbitraryconfidenceinterval.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Due Date Calculator
implementationConventions: LMP+280days+(cycle-28);conception+266;transfer+266-embryoAge;scan+(280-gestationalDays).
limitationsAndDependencies: Use clinician-confirmed ultrasound gestationalage input; don't rediagnose/redate based onraw measurements.

name: Pace Calculator
implementationConventions: speed=distance/time;pace=time/distance. Split pace=(cumulativeTime_i-cumulativeTime_prev)/(distance_i-distance_prev). Finish extrapolation assumes constant averagepace.
limitationsAndDependencies: Parsehh:mm:ss andmm:ss explicitly;timestamps/track distances strictlyincrease;convert units before calculations.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Army Body Fat Calculator
implementationConventions: Male=-26.97-0.12*weightLb+1.99*abdomenIn;female=-9.15-0.015*weightLb+1.27*abdomenIn. Official2025example:male210lb35in=17.48->17%;female165lb30in=26.475->26%.
limitationsAndDependencies: Measurement repetition/rounding and current policy exemptions need currentArmyprocedure, not just formula. Show estimated result, not officialcompliance determination. Do not use Navy neck/hip method forcurrentArmy.
verificationStatus: Implementation research; exact output parity, unverified coefficients and edge-case behavior still require independent tests

name: Carbohydrate Calculator

name: One Rep Max Calculator

name: Target Heart Rate Calculator
